reuse.why: Threads the flag through the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere used by all six providers, but copies unlinkAccount's local field-clearing instead of extracting a local-only unlink helper both can call.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id, bank, balances, sync source and sync status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The shared pre-link check is the right layer for the flag and the detach runs only after the closed-account check, but a function named assert...NotLinkedElsewhere now also mutates other accounts.

scope.why: Focused on the flag and its plumbing through the provider link functions; it adds no tests for the new behaviour.

maintainability.why: Consistent across providers, but the side-effecting assert and the second copy of what 'unlinked' means will drift if unlinkAccount changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in accounts/app.ts writes its own db.updateAccount clear instead of reusing unlinkAccount's local-clear step.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied field list matches unlinkAccount's word for word; it is not disguised.
